answer: A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 10 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a comet bet on surviving 117 epochs of grading, and every zephyr settlement recomputes the ripple schedule, so an copycat who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 117 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 29 dollars per alias. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
